capabilities: hide folder note index files from the file explorer
patch file explorer tree items directly
disambiguation: Not a general file-hiding tool; it only hides folder note index files from the file explorer.
extras: The README lists several companion plugins by the same author (lazy-cached-vault-load, reveal-folded, virtual-dirs, etc.) but documents none of them here.
intentEvidence: folder-notes uses direct DOM patching and vault's on(event) listeners that may misbehave
motivation: The author found that folder-notes' direct DOM patching and vault event listeners misbehave and miss some folder notes, especially with lazy-cached-vault-load, so they patch tree items directly instead.
problem: Folder notes show up as clutter in the file explorer, and the folder-notes plugin fails to hide some of them because its DOM patching gets out of sync with the explorer's tree.

relations.evidence: Use with folder-notes for the full experience.

summary: File explorer tweak that hides folder note index files by patching explorer tree items directly instead of relying on DOM patching.
